devices.*.info.model: Plain identification of the hardware — the SKU label is the whole content.
devices.*.info.name: Plain identification of the hardware — the name is what the user typed in the Govee app.
devices.*.info.serial: Plain identification of the hardware — the serial is the whole content.
devices.*.control.power: A basic light and appliance control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.brightness: A basic light control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.color_rgb: A basic light control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.color_temperature: A basic light control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.humidity: A basic appliance control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.target_temperature: A basic appliance control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.nightlight_toggle: A basic appliance control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.oscillation_toggle: A basic appliance control whose name IS its function, behaving exactly as the role promises.
devices.*.control.nightlight_scene: A dropdown over the night-light scenes the device itself names (Flame, Rainbow, …) — the option list IS the explanation, and it differs per model.
devices.*.scenes.light_scene: A dropdown over Govee's ready-made scenes for this model (Sunrise, Aurora, …) — the option list IS the explanation, and it differs per model.
devices.*.segments.*.color: The same colour control once per segment; segments.count carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
devices.*.segments.*.brightness: The same brightness control once per segment; segments.count carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
devices.*.sensor.temperature: A sensor reading whose unit and role say it all — unlike air quality and filter life, which do carry one.
devices.*.sensor.humidity: A sensor reading whose unit and role say it all — unlike air quality and filter life, which do carry one.
devices.*.sensor.battery: A sensor reading whose unit and role say it all — unlike air quality and filter life, which do carry one.
info.devicesTotal: A plain count of the devices the adapter knows — the name is the whole content.
info.devicesOnline: A plain count of the reachable devices — the name is the whole content; devicesAllOnline carries the explanation for the summary group.
devices.*.control.main_light_toggle: One of the two light groups of a combination device (ceiling-fan light) — an on/off switch whose name IS its function.
devices.*.control.background_light_toggl: One of the two light groups of a combination device (ceiling-fan light) — an on/off switch whose name IS its function.
devices.*.control.fan_toggle: The fan of a ceiling-fan light — an on/off switch whose name IS its function; reverse_airflow_toggle carries the explanation for the direction.
devices.*.control.fan_speed_mode: A dropdown over the speeds the device itself names (Speed 1, Speed 2, …) — the option list IS the explanation, and it differs per model.
groups.*.info.name: Plain identification of the app group — the name is what the user typed in the Govee app.
groups.*.control.power: The group counterpart of the device control, sent to every member at once; info.members carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
groups.*.control.brightness: The group counterpart of the device control, sent to every member at once; info.members carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
groups.*.control.color_rgb: The group counterpart of the device control, sent to every member at once; info.members carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
groups.*.control.color_temperature: The group counterpart of the device control, sent to every member at once; info.members carries the explanation for the whole subtree.
groups.*.scenes.light_scene: A dropdown over the scenes every member of the group knows — the option list IS the explanation, and it differs per group.
